QUOTE: `ServerDataOperator` is an interface that intersects 11 handler mixins from `handlers/` with 3 product mixins from `app/products/`, all built on `ServerDataOperatorBase`.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says ServerDataOperator is an interface extending the mixin types, but it never states that this is a same-named interface merged with the class, so the class ends up typed with every mixed-in method.
